content: soft-webauthn (PyPI, github.com/bodik/soft-webauthn, v0.1.4) provides SoftWebauthnDevice, a software authenticator emulator with create(options, origin) and get(options, origin) methods mirroring navigator.credentials.create()/get(), plus cred_init()/cred_as_attested() for authentication-only tests. Designed specifically for driving py_webauthn's own registration/authentication ceremony functions in a pytest suite with no real browser or hardware key.
